review_text: Great coffee. Clean and peaceful place. Has AC ON even it's early in the morning. It's inside the carwash, you'll see the sign outside ( see the picture below 👇) We ordered Iced Americano and White hot chocolate. Also, we tried their egg tart and it was good👌
Good place to get coffee, much better experience here than KNTO CINCO nearby. Atmosphere is relaxing, staff is friendly.
THE BEST EGG TART! 😍 Good thing may last 2pcs pa for me to eat and one for takeout!
Coffee while having ur car washed. Convenient enough

Ordered carbonara for 230. Plating: 5/5 Taste: 3/5 - The sauce is thin, it hardly sticks to the pasta and the pasta is a bit hard. Portion: 3/5 - small serving for its price. Good place to hang out if you want to get a carwash because it's inside the carwash.
It's nice to chill here in the coffee lounge while doing laundry.
